findingDetails.title: The goal_root mitigation narrows the trust base but leaves it at any directory git lists as a worktree, and the log-naming signal is model-influenced

results.notes: The risk table states the mitigation and the code implements exactly it.
T003 and T004 are backed by the tampered-root test that drops an unlisted goal_root.

noveltyJustification: One new P2 records residual risk the spec already names; no new P0 or P1. The security dimension otherwise produced only ruled-out directions, including an empirical probe that closed the GIT_CONFIG_* question.
classification: security: one P2 residual-risk note; the env scrub, containment check and shell quoting all hold
ruledOut: GIT_CONFIG_* cannot redirect git worktree list; GIT_DIR can and is stripped
a symlinked goal.md inside a worktree cannot escape the real root
shell injection through goal_root is closed by quoted argv at every hop
goal_root discloses no secret the session did not already know
a goal_root of / or a home directory never matches a git-listed worktree
